summaries.en: The ROK-US combined exercise 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' has been cut in half, leading to the cancellation of its second part and some outdoor drills, following a directive from former US President Donald Trump.
summaries.zh: 由于美国前总统特朗普的指示，韩美联合演习“乙支自由之盾”的日程被缩短了一半，导致第二部分反击作战和部分野外机动训练被取消。
